children: Dell increased its full-year fiscal 2027 revenue outlook by $25 billion to $192 billion, up 69% year over year. The company also raised its AI-optimized server revenue forecast to $74 billion from $60 billion. Chief Financial Officer David Kennedy said Dell's competitive advantages reinforce one another, driving growth, share gains and profitability. Full-year EPS guidance rose to $24.37 from $17.31, and non-GAAP EPS guidance increased to $25.50 from $17.90. Third-quarter revenue is expected at $49 billion, an 81% increase.
